description: Defines the 'Teller' entity class with properties, relationships, and methods for JSON conversion and updates within the Fineract project.

classes.name: Teller
classes.description: Entity class representing a Teller with properties like office, accounts, name, description, validity dates, status, and associated cashiers. Includes methods for JSON-based creation and updates.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Teller instance from JSON command data and associated office.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Teller's properties based on JSON command input, tracking changes.

methods.name: officeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated office.

methods.name: initializeLazyCollections
methods.description: Initializes lazy-loaded collections to avoid lazy loading issues.
